name: mystery-forge
description: Generate printable mystery and escape-room games with an AI coding agent.

scripts.check:web: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:web
scripts.check:toolkit: cd toolkit && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy && uv run pytest --cov
scripts.check:skills: cd generator && uv run .pskill/pskill.py validate && uv run .pskill/pskill.py test
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:toolkit && npm run check:skills
